entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Certainly, I can help with that. To pull up your order, can I get your name and the item you're calling about?
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't fit. I keep getting blisters.

I'm very sorry to hear that. That's definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Just to be sure, did you have a chance to properly position the cleats? Sometimes a small adjustment there can resolve pressure points that cause issues like blisters.
Whatever. They're not comfortable. I just want a refund.

I understand completely. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, I see the delivery was 61 days ago. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the window. I can absolutely process that full refund for you.

I've just initiated that for you and sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. And since you're a VIP member with us and this was a frustrating experience, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase. We'd love for you to find something that works perfectly.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, the refund will post to your account in about 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help with today, Alex?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
